bodies: International Board of Credentialing and Continuing Education Standards
Council for Tobacco Treatment Training Programs

exams.name: Certified Rehabilitation Counselor Clinical Supervisor
exams.blurb: Supervisory designation for active CRCs who complete additional supervision training and document experience overseeing rehabilitation counselors.

exams.name: Certified Rehabilitation Counselor Examination
exams.blurb: National examination for counselors helping people with disabilities achieve employment and independence, covering assessment, vocational and case services.

exams.name: International Behavior Analyst
exams.blurb: Graduate-level behaviour analysis credential offered internationally as an alternative pathway, with coursework, supervision and an examination.

exams.name: International Behavior Technician
exams.blurb: Entry-level technician credential for staff delivering direct behaviour-analytic intervention under supervision, based on training and a competency check.

exams.name: Board Certified Art Therapist
exams.blurb: Board certification for registered art therapists, earned by passing the Art Therapy Credentials Board examination after supervised practice.

exams.name: Registered Art Therapist
exams.blurb: Registration credential awarded after a qualifying art therapy master degree and documented postgraduate supervised clinical hours.

exams.name: Board Certified Dance/Movement Therapist
exams.blurb: Advanced dance/movement therapy credential permitting supervision and training of others, requiring documented post-registry clinical practice.

exams.name: Registered Dance/Movement Therapist
exams.blurb: Entry credential for dance/movement therapists following an approved graduate programme and supervised clinical internship hours.

exams.name: Board Certified Trainer in Drama Therapy
exams.blurb: Advanced drama therapy designation authorising holders to train and supervise candidates pursuing the registered drama therapist credential.

exams.name: Registered Drama Therapist
exams.blurb: Credential for therapists using theatre processes clinically, awarded after approved graduate training and supervised drama therapy practice.

exams.name: Psychopharmacology Examination for Psychologists
exams.blurb: Examination used by prescriptive-authority jurisdictions to test psychologists on pharmacology, physiology and medication management.

exams.name: ASCH Certification in Clinical Hypnosis
exams.blurb: Certification for licensed health professionals who complete approved hypnosis training hours, consultation and documented clinical use.

exams.name: Certified Anger Management Specialist
exams.blurb: Tiered credential for practitioners delivering anger management programmes, based on approved training, experience and supervision.

exams.name: Certified Autism Specialist
exams.body: International Board of Credentialing and Continuing Education Standards
exams.blurb: Credential for master-level professionals working with autistic people, requiring documented experience, training hours and a competency examination.

exams.name: Certified Clinical Trauma Professional
exams.blurb: Training-based trauma credential for licensed clinicians covering evidence-based treatment of post-traumatic stress and complex trauma.

exams.name: Certified Employee Assistance Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for workplace behavioural health professionals, tested on assessment, referral, crisis response and organisational consultation.

exams.name: Certified Forensic Mental Health Evaluator
exams.blurb: Credential for licensed clinicians who conduct forensic evaluations and testify, requiring forensic training and an examination.

exams.name: Certified Psychiatric Rehabilitation Practitioner
exams.blurb: National examination-based credential for staff delivering recovery-oriented psychiatric rehabilitation, supported employment and community services.

exams.name: National Certified Peer Specialist
exams.blurb: National credential for mental health peer support workers, requiring lived experience, work hours, training and a certification examination.

exams.name: International Gambling Counselor Certification
exams.blurb: Credential for clinicians treating disordered gambling, requiring specialised training hours, supervised practice and a written examination.

exams.name: MATE Act Substance Use Disorder Training
aka: Medication Access and Training Expansion Act
exams.blurb: Eight hours of training on treating and managing patients with opioid or other substance use disorders, required for most DEA registrants.

exams.name: National Certificate in Tobacco Treatment Practice
exams.body: Council for Tobacco Treatment Training Programs
exams.blurb: National credential for tobacco treatment specialists, requiring accredited training, documented counselling hours and a knowledge examination.

exams.name: Board Certified Music Therapist
exams.blurb: National music therapy credential earned by completing an approved degree and internship then passing the CBMT board certification examination.

exams.name: Certified Poetry Therapist
exams.blurb: Credential for practitioners using literature and writing therapeutically, requiring mentored training hours and a portfolio review.
